subquestions.label: a
subquestions.text:
Draw an EER diagram for the Library Management System scenario below. The system consists of several sections (fiction, children, technology) with unique section names and head librarians. Each book belongs to a section and has attributes like title, authors, ISBN, year, and publisher. A book may have multiple copies identified by access numbers. For each copy borrowed, the current borrower and due date should be tracked. Members have membership numbers, addresses, and phone numbers. Members can borrow 5 books and place hold requests on a book. Librarians have names, IDs, phones, and addresses.

The system also tracks payments made by members for course materials. A payment has a receipt number, amount, and date. Payments are classified into tuition (semester payment), examination fees, and library fines. The system should ensure data integrity and enforce constraints like unique section names, valid ISBNs, and non-negative payment amounts.

[PLACEHOLDER FIGURE] (Describe the EER diagram showing entities, attributes, and relationships)
